create_timer_instance: create a Timer instance to measure elapsed time between tic and toc calls
start_timer_with_tic: start the timer by calling tic on a Timer instance to record the start time
stop_timer_with_toc: stop the timer by calling toc to compute elapsed time and update average time
reset_timer_state: reset all accumulated timing data including total time, calls, and average time to zero
measure_code_execution_time: measure code execution time by calling tic before and toc after the code block
